plain_english_revision: The amendment modifies the qualifications and powers of school resource officers by requiring specialized youth training, limiting arrest authority to certified officers only.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment restricts the power of school resource officers by mandating specialized youth training and limiting arrest authority to those certified by the Alabama Peace Officers' Standards and Training Commission.
evidence_quotes: (5) He or she has received specialized training to work with youth at a school site.
(c) Only those school resource officers who are certified by the Alabama Peace Officers' Standards and Training Commission shall have the power of arrest.
